summary: Pending temporary access approvals cleared after Okta backfill updated lastLogin attribute
description:
Issue summary: Several internal users reported that their pending temporary access requests in the Support Portal disappeared after their manager approved them. Impact: Users who had manager-approved temporary access saw the approval disappear and were not granted the expected console/runbook permissions for internal tools (notably model-insights and runbooks). This affected engineers requiring immediate elevated permissions for oncall tasks. Root cause hypothesis: An Okta SCIM/attribute backfill job updated the 'lastLogin' attribute for a cohort of historical users. The entitlement evaluation service treats certain identity attributes as authoritative triggers for re-evaluating pending requests; the backfill caused the entitlement engine to re-evaluate and clear pending approvals when lastLogin appeared older than policy threshold.

Observed: Pending approvals vanished within a 10-minute window starting 2026-03-01 03:12 UTC. No bulk deletion events were recorded in the support-portal DB; instead the entitlement cache showed invalidated pending_grants keys for affected users.

Expected: Manager-approved temporary access flows should persist until the request is consumed or explicitly revoked; identity attribute backfills should not silently clear already-approved pending grants.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Create a temporary access request in Support Portal for a test user (role: runbook-elevate) with manager approval required.
2) Approve the request from manager account; observe pending_grant created with TTL and status 'Approved - pending consumption'.
3) Simulate SCIM attribute sync that patches 'lastLogin' to an older timestamp for the user (payload mirrors Okta backfill job).
4) Observe entitlement service logs and Support Portal: pending_grant is invalidated and request status becomes 'stale/missing'.
logs: 2026-03-01T03:12:37Z identity-proxy INFO Received SCIM PATCH for user uid=eng123 (fields: lastLogin).
2026-03-01T03:12:40Z entitlement-service WARN Re-evaluating pending_grant=pg_7f4b due to attribute change (lastLogin).
2026-03-01T03:12:41Z entitlement-service INFO pending_grant=pg_7f4b status cleared -> reason=attribute_policy_mismatch
2026-03-01T03:12:43Z support-portal INFO Pending grant pg_7f4b removed from UI cache for user eng123
No delete rows in support_portal.pending_approvals table; change originated from entitlement cache layer.
investigation_notes: Initial triage by Support (Ethan): correlated multiple Slack reports in #internal-support starting 03:15 UTC. Affected users share a recent Okta bulk attribute update window.
Identity team (Ravi) confirmed a scheduled backfill job ran 03:10-03:20 UTC to populate historical lastLogin values for legacy accounts (intended for analytics only).

Entitlement service (Naomi) logs show a rule: if lastLogin > 30 days ago mark pending grants as 'stale' to prevent granting to dormant accounts. The rule assumed lastLogin only changes on user activity; backfill broke that assumption.
Repro: running a scoped SCIM PATCH reproduced the state change locally against a staging entitlement-cache and cleared pending_grants as observed in prod.
No evidence of malicious activity; change caused by trusted Okta job.
comments: Ethan Martinez (Support): 'Multiple engineers reported manager-approved requests disappearing around 03:15 UTC. Triage suggests identity attribute updates correlated.'
Ravi Desai (Identity): 'Backfill job executed as scheduled to backfill lastLogin from legacy logs. We did not expect entitlement re-eval to consider backfills authoritative.'
Naomi Patel (Entitlements): 'Found entitlement rule that treats lastLogin as a freshness signal. I'm preparing a fix to ignore lastLogin changes when a pending_grant exists. Hotfix planned.'
SRE (Lina Huang): 'We scoped the affected user cohort to ~42 accounts in prod us-east. No DB deletes; cache-only invalidation. Rolling rollback of SCIM job patch payloads in progress.'
Alice Chen (Manager/affected): 'Access disappeared after I approved — blocked on urgent debug task. Thanks for fast response.'
resolution_notes: Mitigation: Identity team rolled back the backfill PATCH batch at 03:38 UTC to stop further attr updates. Support team re-queued the affected pending grants and manually re-applied approvals for the 42 impacted users. Hotfix: entitlement-service PR #1428 changes evaluation logic to ignore 'lastLogin' attribute updates when a pending_grant exists (merged 2026-03-02). Deployed hotfix to prod us-east 2026-03-02 21:05 UTC. Follow-ups: (1) Add a gating rule to ignore Okta backfill syncs (SCIM source tag) for entitlement re-evaluations, (2) Add an audit flagging alert when >10 pending_grants are invalidated in a 5m window, (3) Update Identity team's runbook to mark certain backfills as 'non-authoritative' for entitlement systems. No further incidents observed after hotfix.
